proved_exactly.claim: The valency-15 chamber graph has exactly 135 maximal K4s, is transitive on them, and has 540 chamber-K4 incidences.
A K4 stabilizer has order 192 and center order 2; its central quotient is explicitly isomorphic as a marked four-generator group to Aut(tomotope), order 96.
The order-192 K4 stabilizer is not C2 x Aut(tomotope), as shown by the unequal element-order censuses.
The four order-648 parabolics have pair intersections 24^5 and 54^1, all triple intersections order 3, trivial total core, and panel thickness 3.

The natural four-parabolic coset geometry is not an abstract polytope because its rank-one residues have three chambers rather than two; its panel moves are C3 rotations rather than exchange involutions.

For any nonsingular integral rank-24 Gram matrix G, the block form [[G,I],[I,0]] is even unimodular of determinant 1; for the positive W33 projector Gram it has signature (24,24), hence realizes II_24,24.
The rank-24 U4(2) module has dim Hom_G(Sym^2 V,V)=2 and dim Hom_G(wedge^2 V,V)=1.
Projected coordinatewise multiplication and projected triangle-neighbour multiplication are independent, Frobenius, and span the complete U4(2)-equivariant commutative product space.
No nonzero product in that two-dimensional commutative envelope is associative over Q; a coprime associator pair already proves this modulo 1000003.
The eta-quotient formulas reproduce the first coefficients of the 2A/2B, 3A/3B, and 5A/5B McKay-Thompson channels exactly.
The W33 -4 eigenspace and the chamber-complement -4 eigenspace are both irreducible 15-dimensional U4(2) modules but have character inner product zero, so they are inequivalent.
